actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Idempotent create replay publishes analysis again
actions_or_findings.trigger: A resident repeats POST /work-orders with the same idempotency key.
actions_or_findings.rationale: _create_work_order returns the existing order at line 809, but create_work_order always calls _enqueue_analysis at line 327. The order stays unique while the isolated queue receives another task, so the exactly-once publish condition is unmet.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Completion history credits earlier assignees for another employee's work
actions_or_findings.trigger: An order is reassigned and its later handler completes it.
actions_or_findings.rationale: get_dispatch_history calculates each employee's completion rate from the order's current status. Every former assignee of a CLOSED order receives completion credit. This distorts one of the seven ranking factors; the same-building query at lines 308-325 also counts assignments without establishing completed work.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Admin-only and disabled capabilities can pass dispatch filtering
actions_or_findings.trigger: An active, checked-in employee has matching capability links but only an admin role, or a linked duty or skill has DISABLED status.
actions_or_findings.rationale: _STAFF_ROLES accepts SUPERVISOR, PROPERTY_ADMIN and TENANT_ADMIN without STAFF. AiRepository.list_employee_duties/list_employee_skills at lines 140-153 do not require ACTIVE catalog rows. The recommendation path repeats these rules in analysis.py. This does not enforce the scoped STAFF and usable duty/skill filter required by docs/05 §4.1.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Repeated capability add writes a false audit delta
actions_or_findings.trigger: PATCH /admin/employees/{id} repeats an already linked add_duty_ids or add_skill_ids value.
actions_or_findings.rationale: _add_duties/_add_skills skip existing links, but the audit records every requested ID as added at lines 603-606. Concurrent identical adds can instead hit the unique constraint and return a generic 409. State is protected from duplicate links, but the append-only change record is inaccurate and repeat behavior is not idempotent.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Saved database evidence does not establish the required order 3 and order 4 boundaries
actions_or_findings.trigger: The review checks NOT_CHECKED_IN for order 3 and the same-order AUTO, audit, load and notification records for the page-created order 4.
actions_or_findings.rationale: runtime-evidence.json summarizes order 2; page-evidence.json and screenshots concern order 4. No redacted inspector output for orders 3 or 4 is saved. Worker logs show order 3 NO_ELIGIBLE and order 4 ASSIGNED, but do not show order 3's persisted filter reason or order 4's database audit and load rows. The inspector also selects audits by request_id alone at line 97, which can attribute another resource's audit to the order.
